relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Upon activation of TRPV1, CGRP and SP are released, causing vasodilation and triggering NI in the meninges [75,76].

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: endogenously released inflammatory mediators such as bradykinin, serotonin (5-HT), PGs, or histamine can influence TRPV1 activity, mainly indirectly through the stimulation of their receptors and the generation of second messengers

relationships.subject: SB-705498
relationships.evidence_quote: which results in rapid and reversible inhibition of capsaicin-, acid (pH 5.3)-, or heat (50 °C)-mediated activation of human TRPV1

key_findings: Review: TRP channels, esp. TRPV1, drive CGRP/SP release and meningeal nociceptor activation in migraine; TRPV1 antagonist SB-705498 failed against migraine in Phase II.
